quotes.author: Toniann Keiling
quotes.text: Captain Mike was welcoming, fun, and knew how to make our trip as fun as possible. He let us play the music we liked, dance our booties off, and swim in the bay. We even asked for him to setup a slide we saw in online photos and he let us slide into the bay. This was one of the most memorable parts of my cousin’s bachelorette weekend. If you’re on the fence, just book the trip with Mike and get ready for lots of fun!

quotes.author: Mary Beth Dwyer
quotes.text: Amazing day with captain Mike is awesome and our crew had a great time! It was a late August day so a bit chilly and windy and he knew exactly where to take us so that we were comfortable and protected in the bay. Already talking about the next time we can get out with Mike on the Hamptiki!

quotes.author: Susan Harlin
quotes.text: We had an awesome time celebrating my husband’s 70th birthday with Captain Mike on the Hamptiki. Captain Mike couldn’t do enough to make our experience memorable.

quotes.author: Cynthia Moslander
quotes.text: So much fun! Celebrating a birthday on the water was perfect. Captain Mike was fun, knowledgeable and a great captain. We will surely book Hamptiki again!

quotes.author: Edward Moslander
quotes.text: We had so much fun! Great vessel, Captain Mike knows every current and eddy in those bays. And he’s great company. May make this an annual event.

quotes.text: Posted on Google William Langsamb Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. All we wished for. Entire group enjoyed
